title: Our Flat
text:
This is our flat. It is on the second floor. There is a small living room with a sofa and a TV. The sofa is brown.

The bathroom is next to the bedroom. In the bedroom there is a big bed and a wardrobe. My cat sleeps on the bed every night.

options: A big bed and a wardrobe

questions.text: Why is the cat probably comfortable in the bedroom?
options: The bed is soft and warm
The cat does not like the bed

questions.text: What kind of home is this most likely to be?

vocabulary.definition: a long soft seat for two or more people
a room with a bath or shower and a toilet
a tall cupboard for keeping clothes

paragraph_translations: Bu bizim dairemiz. İkinci katta. Küçük bir oturma odası var; içinde bir koltuk ve bir televizyon var. Koltuk kahverengi.
Banyo yatak odasının yanında. Yatak odasında büyük bir yatak ve bir gardırop var. Kedim her gece yatakta uyur.
